facts.fact: The e-Governance Academy says its experts supported ANSIE in setting up a national data exchange layer and trained staff to deploy and work with the solution on national scale, in a project run May 2022 to April 2023 and marked finished; the page does not say the layer is live.

The e-Governance Academy says a functional and integrated X-Road secure data exchange with PKI was implemented for ANSIE between government registries and databases, and that the government of Djibouti has the X-Road data exchange system in place; the date is the project's end month, taken from the published date.

note: The page gives no count of connected systems and no usage figure.

facts.fact: The director general of the population directorate says it is working on an interoperability system that will let public administrations, and some institutions such as banks and social protection bodies, check a national ID card's authenticity in real time; no launch is stated.

systems.owner: Direction générale de la Population et de la Famille
systems.tiers: public administrations, banks, social protection bodies

note: Date is the document's published date, which the interview gives no separate event date for.

systems.system: Plate-forme d'échange des données (art. 38, to be set up by the Direction de l'Exécution Budgétaire with all central-administration departments)
systems.owner: Direction de l'Exécution Budgétaire (Ministry of the Budget)
Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects

note: Art. 38 of the 2026 budget law only orders the Direction de l'Exécution Budgétaire to set up a data-exchange platform with central-administration departments; it states no procurement, build or pilot, so no underway or in-service fact; e-Guichet is a customs single window, class other.

facts.fact: The Council of Ministers communique of 14 January 2025 names X-Road supports among items in ANSIE's 2025 budget, with no bodies connected or use stated.
